system_prompt:
# Baseline Agent

You are a customer service agent. Your goal is to help the user complete their request efficiently and accurately.

## Instructions

- Identify what the user needs and take action to resolve it.
- Use the available tools to look up information and perform actions.
- Be helpful, clear, and professional.
- If you cannot help with a request, transfer to a human agent.
- Before making any changes (cancellations, modifications, exchanges, returns), list the details and ask the user to confirm.

messages.content: Hi, this is Sophia Martin. I think there was a mixup with my assistant and I may have booked multiple flights for the same day. Could you please check my profile and see if there are any overlapping or duplicate bookings? I know I’ll be arriving in New York from Dallas on May 17, and I’ll be leaving Boston on May 22. Can you help me figure out which flights should be cancelled? Thank you!

Thanks, Sophia — I can help with that. First I’ll need your user id to look up your profile (I can’t access accounts by name alone). Could you please provide your user id?

A few quick confirmations before I check:
- You said you’ll be arriving in New York from Dallas on May 17 and departing Boston on May 22 — is that correct?
- Do you want me to only look for overlapping/duplicate bookings on those dates, or scan your whole profile for any same-day/duplicate reservations?
- If I find duplicates, do you want me to cancel them for you, or just list them so you can tell me which to cancel? (If you want cancellations, I will list each cancellation and ask for your explicit "yes" before making any changes.)

Once you send your user id (and any preference above), I’ll pull your reservations and report back with what I find.

Sure, my user id is sophia_martin_4574.

Yes, that's correct—I’ll be arriving in New York from Dallas on May 17 and departing Boston on May 22.

If possible, could you scan my whole profile for any same-day or duplicate reservations? I’d appreciate it if you could list what you find, and then I’ll let you know which ones to cancel. Thanks for your help!

Thanks — I tried to pull your profile (sophia_martin_4574) but the system returned an error when accessing your account. I can proceed two ways — which do you prefer?

1) I can try again right now to load your profile and scan for same-day or duplicate reservations. (If I find any, I will list them and then wait for your explicit "yes" before cancelling anything.) — say “retry” to proceed.

2) If you have the reservation IDs handy, you can paste them here and I’ll inspect those directly.

3) If you’d rather have a human agent handle this, I can transfer you. (I’ll initiate the transfer and then send a confirmation message.)

Please tell me which option you want, and I’ll take the next step.
Let’s go with option 1 — please retry accessing my profile. I don’t have the reservation IDs handy right now. Thanks!

arguments.summary: User sophia_martin_4574 unable to access profile due to repeated system errors.
